description: This file defines a React functional component 'LearningPathStepper' that renders a user interface element showing enrolled learning paths and their progress within a learning platform. It manages display states based on user's enrolled paths and their course completion, involving UI rendering and data fetching.

methods.name: LearningPathStepper
methods.description: React functional component that displays active learning paths and progress or a prompt to enroll if no paths are active.
